title: Lane keeper bench · Level 2: Cones
brief: The level 1 loop with four cones (50 mm across, 100 mm tall, 30 g, loose) in the lane, 100 mm from its centre: a red one left of the centre, keep it on your left (pass on its right); a green one right of it, keep it on your right. Their places and colours are drawn each run: one in each 1250 mm of the lane from 500 mm to 5500 mm along it, at least 600 mm apart. Each lap, as the robot's centre passes a cone, it must be on the cone's far side from the centre line; a cone passed on the wrong side or knocked (touched, once a cone) costs 25. Two laps, clock from the start line (300 mm along) to the second lap's crossing; a departure is a wheel's middle over a line or crossing it, and a wheel outside counts one more each second; the fourth ends the run. Score: 100 x min(1.2, par / T) - 15 per departure - 25 per cone wrong or knocked, between 0 and 100; 0 if not finished. Par 23.8 s. Bench level, not scored for a pass: the runner writes cones.json to the flash, the cones' places as [mm along the lane, colour], for a stand-in camera.

score.run: if(finished, clamp(100 * min(1.2, par / lapTime) - 15 * departures - 25 * (conesWrong + conesKnocked), 0, 100), 0)
score.summary: round(sum(r in runs: r.points) / count(r in runs: true), 1)
